name: nv-gateway
description: Free Windows desktop gateway for NVIDIA NGC/NIM: 100+ models, OpenAI+Anthropic compatible local API, multi-key rotation & failover
author: HaYkMnE

scripts.build: tsc --project tsconfig.json --noEmit && vite build && tsc --project tsconfig.node.json
scripts.build:portable: npm run build && node scripts/run-electron-builder.mjs --win portable && npm run package:audit
scripts.build:release: npm run build && node scripts/run-electron-builder.mjs --win --publish never && npm run package:audit
scripts.package:dir: npm run build && node scripts/run-electron-builder.mjs --dir && npm run package:audit
scripts.package:audit: npm run test:packaged-migration && npm run test:packaged-security && npm run test:packaged-gateway-link && npm run test:packaged-credentials
